item.title: [8] Electrically controllable superconducting memory effect in UTe2
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: F. Malte Grosche, Alexander G. Eaton

Authors: Zheyu Wu, Hanyi Chen, Mengmeng Long, et al.

Score 8/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Directly relevant study of unconventional superconductivity in p-wave candidate UTe2.

Tags: #material #superconductivity #heavy-fermion #UTe2

Abstract: Observations of a memory effect in the p-wave superconductor candidate UTe2, which can be controlled by varying the strength and duration of the electrically applied stimuli, are described.
